questions.stem: If an iterative formula converges to $x = 1.5$, which equation does $x = 1.5$ approximately satisfy?

options.text: The original equation that was rearranged into the iterative formula

questions.explanation: When the iteration converges, setting $x_{n+1} = x_n = x$ in the iterative formula gives the original equation. So the limit is an approximate solution to the original equation.
